The buttons on the keypad lack distinct separation lines and individual keycap definitions. They appear slightly fused or 'melted' into the surrounding casing, with soft, indistinct edges rather than sharp mechanical boundaries.

The black protrusion at the top left corner has an ambiguous geometry. It does not clearly connect to the main body with a defined joint or screw point, appearing somewhat floating or organically merged with the casing.
